name: RBI
intro: RBI application forms use the standard bank recruitment format: a photograph, a signature, a left thumb impression and a handwritten declaration.

documents.label: Photograph
documents.caption: none
notes: Recent colour passport-style photo on a light background.
Face the camera; no caps or dark glasses.

documents.label: Signature
notes: Sign in black ink on white paper.
Signatures in capital letters are not accepted.

documents.label: Left thumb impression
notes: Black or blue ink on white paper.
If your left thumb is unavailable, the right thumb may be used.

documents.label: Handwritten declaration
notes: Write it yourself, in English, in black ink on white paper. Typed text is rejected.
Text: I, (your name), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.

source.label: Standard bank recruitment image rules (official IPPB notification) and a summary of RBI Grade B 2026 rules; check the RBI notification

faqs.q: What is the RBI photo size?
faqs.a: 200 × 230 pixels (about 3.5 × 4.5 cm at 200 DPI), JPG, between 20 KB and 50 KB.

faqs.q: What is the RBI signature size?
faqs.a: 140 × 60 pixels at 200 DPI, JPG, between 10 KB and 20 KB.
